# NEW 2026-11-18 court offices: people and affairs (oe_cof). Generated by gen_court_offices_story.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# BYZ scope, monthly (on_action oe_cof_pulse).
oe_cof_monthly = {
    oe_cof_linkage = yes
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cof_gate = yes NOT = { has_variable = oe_cof_cd } oe_story_gap_open = yes oe_cof_any_story = yes }
        random = { chance = 8 oe_cof_dispatch = yes }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Picks one eligible court story by weight.
oe_cof_dispatch = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_cof } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_cof value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_cof add = 1 }  # third round T3: event count
    set_variable = { name = oe_cof_cd months = 8 }
    oe_story_gap_set = yes
    random_list = {
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_1 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_1 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.1 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_2 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_2 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.2 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_3 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_3 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.3 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_4 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_4 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.4 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_5 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_5 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.5 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_6 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_6 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.6 }
        15 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_7 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_7 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.7 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_8 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_8 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.8 }
        25 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_9 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_9 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.9 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_10 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_10 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.10 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_11 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_11 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.11 }
        15 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_12 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_12 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.12 }
        10 = { trigger = { oe_cof_ok_13 = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cof_done_13 years = 20 } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_cof.13 }
    }
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. The Domestikos and the Megas Doux act on the running campaign. The net monthly change made
# here is kept in var:oe_cof_press_month for display.
oe_cof_linkage = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_cof_press_month value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cof_campaign_on = yes oe_court_domestikos_filled = yes var:oe_court_domestikos = { mil >= 60 } }
        oe_cof_pressure = { amount = -1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cof_press_month add = -1 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_command months = 2 mode = replace }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_inept } remove_country_modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_inept }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { oe_cof_campaign_on = yes oe_court_domestikos_filled = yes var:oe_court_domestikos = { mil < 30 } }
        oe_cof_pressure = { amount = 1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cof_press_month add = 1 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_inept months = 2 mode = replace }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_command } remove_country_modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_command }
    }
    else = {
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_command } remove_country_modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_command }
        if = { limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_inept } remove_country_modifier = oe_cof_domestikos_inept }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { oe_cof_sea_campaign_on = yes oe_court_admiral_filled = yes var:oe_court_admiral = { mil >= 60 } }
        oe_cof_pressure = { amount = -1 }
        change_variable = { name = oe_cof_press_month add = -1 }
        add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cof_admiral_convoys months = 2 mode = replace }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_cof_admiral_convoys }
        remove_country_modifier = oe_cof_admiral_convoys
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Changes the pressure of whichever campaign is running (only one runs at a time).
oe_cof_pressure = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_egypt_active } oe_hc_egypt_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_africa_active } oe_hc_africa_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_italy_active } oe_hc_italy_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_france_active } oe_hc_france_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_iberia_active } oe_hc_iberia_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_britain_active } oe_hc_britain_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_persia_active } oe_hc_persia_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_blacksea_active } oe_hc_blacksea_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } } else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_hc_arabia_active } oe_hc_arabia_add_pressure = { amount = $amount$ } }
}

# BYZ scope; var:oe_cof_slot was set by the event (oe_cof.8). Influence of that great house.
oe_cof_family_influence = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_cof_slot ?= 1 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 1 amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_cof_slot ?= 2 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 2 amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_cof_slot ?= 3 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 3 amount = $amount$ } } } else_if = { limit = { var:oe_cof_slot ?= 4 } international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = { oe_nf_change_influence = { slot = 4 amount = $amount$ } } }
}
# BYZ scope. Influence of the holder's house, if he belongs to a registered great house.
oe_cof_house_holder = {
    scope:oe_cof_holder ?= { if = { limit = { oe_cof_in_house = yes } oe_nf_member_influence = { amount = $amount$ } } }
}
oe_cof_house_holder2 = {
    scope:oe_cof_holder2 ?= { if = { limit = { oe_cof_in_house = yes } oe_nf_member_influence = { amount = $amount$ } } }
}

# Test helpers. Console: 'effect oe_cof_test_story = yes' (next eligible story now), 'effect oe_cof_test_reset = yes'.
oe_cof_test_story = {
    if = { limit = { oe_cof_any_story = yes } oe_cof_dispatch = yes }
}
oe_cof_test_reset = {
    remove_variable = oe_cof_cd
    oe_story_gap_clear = yes
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_1
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_2
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_3
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_4
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_5
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_6
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_7
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_8
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_9
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_10
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_11
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_12
    remove_variable = oe_cof_done_13
}

# BYZ scope. Removes the Grand Chancellor: the same effect as the author's dismiss button (scripted_guis/oe_court_offices.txt);
# the 5 legitimacy the button costs is applied by the option itself when the dismissal is without cause.
oe_cof_dismiss_chancellor = {
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_court_chancellor }
        var:oe_court_chancellor ?= { remove_variable = oe_court_office_held }
        remove_variable = oe_court_chancellor
    }
}
# BYZ scope. scope:oe_cof_cand becomes Grand Chancellor: the same effect as the author's appoint action (generic_actions/oe_court_offices.txt).
oe_cof_appoint_chancellor = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_cof_cand scope:oe_cof_cand = { oe_court_candidate = yes } NOT = { oe_court_chancellor_filled = yes } }
        oe_court_clear_invalid = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_court_chancellor value = scope:oe_cof_cand }
        scope:oe_cof_cand = { set_variable = oe_court_office_held }
    }
}
